sentimento.text1: 70 days from the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), a Sunday of party conventions and no new poll. The [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) of Jul 24 (n=2,004, fieldwork Jul 22 to 24, 2pp margin, BR-01166/2026) is still the most recent national read, with Lula at 40% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 32% in the first round and 48% x 43% in the head-to-head [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). The week ahead changes that: the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) register shows four national polls with publication declared within five days, [Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) on Jul 27, [AtlasIntel](/en/glossary#atlasintel) on Jul 28 with n=5,000, PoderData on Jul 30 with n=2,400 and Vox Brasil on Jul 31 with n=2,100. Three of them have fieldwork open right now, meaning they are measuring after the [PL](/en/glossary#pl) convention. A filing declared to the TSE is not guaranteed publication, and dates slip.
sentimento.text2: In the market, the day was one of internal reshuffling and not of a changed picture. Lula did not move, staying at the same 62.50% (vol USD 7.65M) that is the top of the AFOS series. Flávio rose 0.80pp to 23.65% (vol USD 7.67M) and Renan Santos fell 0.80pp to 9.55% (vol USD 8.53M), a move of the same size and opposite sign between two names in the same camp, with the front-runner standing still. Lula’s gap over Flávio pulled back to +38.85pp, off the peak of +39.65pp recorded yesterday. Total accumulated volume in the presidential market at USD 115.95M. Capture at 2:12pm BRT, approved by the double-reading guard with an 8 minute interval, and confirmed by a third reading.
sentimento.text3: The fact of the day was the PSD national convention, which made Ronaldo Caiado its presidential candidate with Gilberto Kassab as running mate, a ticket built entirely within the party. In his first speech as a candidate, Caiado attacked both front-runners, saying that Lula provokes Trump and that Flávio attacks public authorities (Folha de S.Paulo, G1, Times Brasil, Jul 26). His price in the book fell 0.15pp, to 1.75%, on the very same day. It is the second launch in a row in which the candidate being made official ends the session down, after Flávio fell 0.10pp the day before. The coincidence is recorded twice and causation is asserted in neither case: a thin book and a single-instant capture do not support attribution.
sentimento.direita: Flávio recovered 0.80pp and returned to 23.65%, moving away from the 22.00% floor the series records on Jul 3, and consolidated second place in the first round at 78.00%, up 1.50pp. His gain came in exactly the same size as Renan Santos’ loss, which describes reallocation within the camp rather than a transfer between camps, since Lula did not move. On the other side of that ledger, the surrounding names retreated: Jair fell 0.20pp to 1.05% and Michelle fell 0.40pp to 0.75% (vol USD 9.26M), dropping out of the 1% range she had crossed the day before. The most recent poll is still the Datafolha of Jul 24, with 32% in the first round and a 48% rejection rate, the highest in the race.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula stood exactly still at 62.50% (vol USD 7.65M), which is the top of the entire AFOS series. There was no new poll to test the level, and the Datafolha of Jul 24 remains the reference, with 40% in the first round, 48% in the runoff against Flávio and personal approval of 49% against 48%. The news on his side today is diplomatic, not electoral: the government summoned Brazil’s ambassador in Argentina for consultations after Javier Milei called Alexandre de Moraes a bald piece of trash from a stage in Brazil (Folha de S.Paulo, Jul 26). The market priced none of that, and standing still at the top after two days of escalation is the record that matters.
sentimento.terceiraVia: The chasing pack had its busiest day on the calendar and its quietest day in price. Caiado was made the PSD candidate, with Kassab as running mate, and fell 0.15pp to 1.75% (vol USD 5.14M), also giving up 0.50pp in the first-round third place market, to 15.50%. Zema fell 0.10pp to 0.65% (vol USD 4.53M) and still has no running mate announced, with conventions running through Aug 5. Haddad fell 0.30pp to 0.35% (vol USD 6.36M) and dropped out of the half-point range. Renan Santos lost 0.80pp in the winner market and 1.50pp in third place, to 64.50%, but still holds the largest accumulated volume among the competitive names.
sentimento.polymarket: Lula 62.50% (flat, vol USD 7.65M), Flávio 23.65% (up 0.80pp, vol USD 7.67M), Renan 9.55% (down 0.80pp, vol USD 8.53M), Caiado 1.75% (down 0.15pp, vol USD 5.14M), Jair 1.05% (down 0.20pp, vol USD 5.24M), Michelle 0.75% (down 0.40pp, vol USD 9.26M), Zema 0.65% (down 0.10pp, vol USD 4.53M), Camilo Santana 0.45%, Haddad 0.35% (down 0.30pp, vol USD 6.36M), Alckmin 0.25%, Tarcísio 0.15% (flat, vol USD 13.63M), Tereza Cristina 0.15%. Lula’s gap over Flávio at +38.85pp, down 0.80pp against yesterday. Total accumulated volume in the presidential market at USD 115.95M. Capture Jul 26, 17:12 UTC, confirmed by a double reading with an 8 minute interval.

inss.text1: 70 days from the election, the fiscal agenda is still stuck and had no new development on Sunday: the Senate is in recess, the government’s priority bills were not voted on, and Davi Alcolumbre is holding back promulgation of the [pauta-bomba](/en/glossary#pauta-bomba) pending a conversation with Lula. The external axis, which last week was commercial with the new American tariff package, turned diplomatic and institutional over the weekend, and it is that axis which dominates Sunday coverage.
inss.text2: The market did not move the front-runner’s price in either direction: Lula stayed at exactly 62.50%, with no change, over a weekend of diplomatic escalation with Argentina and the launch of a third candidate. When the front-runner’s price stands still and all the movement happens between the second and third placed names, the honest reading is a reshuffle within the chasing field, not a change of scenario. The polls had no way to test that, because no new national survey was published, and the next one arrives on Jul 27.
inss.text3: The market on the impeachment of a [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice fell 0.10pp and stood at 3.40% (vol USD 83 thousand), effectively flat for the third day. The methodological caveat weighs more than the number: with USD 83 thousand in accumulated volume against USD 115.95M in the presidential market, this book is orders of magnitude smaller and variation in it does not support a narrative. What matters to record is the absence of movement across two days in which a foreign head of state attacked a justice of the Court from a Brazilian stage, the president of the Court answered publicly and the government summoned an ambassador. Real money went on treating the picture as friction, not as rupture.
inss.text4: On the electoral front, Sunday was about the calendar and not about data. The PSD made Caiado its presidential candidate with Kassab as running mate, and in the book his price fell 0.15pp to 1.75%. Next week brings the measurement: four national polls with publication declared to the TSE between Jul 27 and Jul 31, with the AtlasIntel of Jul 28 the largest in sample, at n=5,000, and the first big one whose fieldwork sits entirely after the PL convention. Until then, the Datafolha of Jul 24 remains the heaviest poll in the set.
inss.impactoLula: No new approval reading this Sunday. The reference is still the Datafolha of Jul 24: Lula’s personal approval at 49% against 48% disapproval, with 3% who do not know, against 48% x 49% in the previous round. The two ends swapped places by 1pp in a survey with a 2pp margin, which is a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) in both rounds and not a reversal, and the honest reading is stability. The earlier ones: PoderData Jul 22 at 46% x 47%, Indexa Jul 21 at 49% x 48%, Real Time Jul 21 at 46% x 50%, Genial/[Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) Jul 15 at 48% x 47% and PoderData/Aya Jul 16 at 42% x 51%.
inss.impactoGestao: The assessment of the ADMINISTRATION is a different question from personal approval, and the distance between the two remains the interesting data point: in the Datafolha of Jul 24, 38% rate the government as bad or terrible, 32% as great or good and 28% as average. Voters approve of the person more than they approve of the administration. On inflation, the market kept the modal band at 5.00% to 5.49%, priced at 39.20%, followed by the 4.50% to 4.99% band at 26.20% and the 5.50% to 5.99% band at 12.15% ([Polymarket](/en/glossary#polymarket)). The centre of the distribution remains above the target ceiling, with the whole book adding up to USD 77 thousand in volume.
inss.conclusao: 70 days from the election, Sunday showed a market reshuffling internally without changing its mind about the outcome. Lula stood still at 62.50%, at the top of the series, while Flávio rose 0.80pp and Renan fell exactly 0.80pp, which describes a dispute within one camp and not between camps. The gap pulled back from +39.65pp to +38.85pp, off yesterday’s peak without giving back the level of the week. A third candidate was made official and his price fell. None of that was tested by polling, because there was no new national survey, and that is precisely what next week will do, with four national polls due between Jul 27 and Jul 31.

bancoMaster.text1: No new procedural development captured in the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) case this Sunday. The caveat is methodological and has to come before the content: the specific news query on Master, Vorcaro, STF, INSS and the congressional inquiry returned ZERO items in today’s collection, which may be a short window, an aggregator filter or bot blocking. Absence of search results is not evidence of absence of facts, and for that reason the card keeps the previous picture instead of declaring an empty day.
bancoMaster.text2: The picture that still holds has two strands that should not be conflated. On the asset side, the Rio de Janeiro courts ordered accounts of Banco Master, Trustee DTVM, Axor Asset and two partners, Alexandre Marchesani Canata and Felipe Mota Separovic Rodrigues, to be frozen up to R$ 135 million, in a ruling by judge Wladimir Hungria of the Public Treasury Court, at the request of the state and of Rioprevidência. The origin is a R$ 150 million allocation made by Rioprevidência into the Texas i Fia fund between Jul 4 and Aug 8 of 2025, with the portfolio almost entirely exposed to Ambipar shares.
bancoMaster.text3: On the criminal side, the inquiry authorised by André Mendonça on Jul 23 into Daniel Vorcaro’s payments for the film about Jair Bolsonaro continues, with a scope of corruption and money laundering. In the market, neither strand had an identifiable price counterpart today. Flávio rose 0.80pp, but the move mirrors exactly Renan Santos’ fall and happens over a weekend dominated by a convention and by diplomatic friction, which makes attribution to the Master case indefensible. The impeachment market for a justice was effectively flat at 3.40%.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The two strands of the Master case keep running on separate tracks and should not be added together: the criminal one, at the STF, still under investigation, and the asset one, in the Rio courts, with a defined amount and defined defendants. What real money says about both is the same thing it has been saying, which is almost nothing. Today’s honest record is twofold: no new fact was captured, and the capture itself failed in this category, so the card’s silence describes the collection and not necessarily the day.

stf.toffoli: Toffoli remains isolated on the STF after the Master crisis, with no new individual action captured over the weekend.
stf.moraes: He was named as a target without having taken any new action, and the episode gained an institutional aftermath. After Javier Milei called him a bald piece of trash from the stage of the PL convention on Jul 25, the president of the STF, Edson Fachin, replied publicly that the remark is incompatible with civility and defended the Court (G1, Estadão, Folha de S.Paulo, Jul 25). On Jul 26, the Brazilian government summoned its ambassador in Argentina for consultations, raising the episode from a campaign remark to a diplomatic incident.
stf.gilmar: No individual action by Gilmar in the period. The recent joint vote stands, with Dino, Moraes and Zanin, which reduced restrictions on [penduricalhos](/en/glossary#penduricalhos).
stf.dino: No individual decision by Dino in the period. He remains a target of the Bolsonarist camp and the recent joint vote on penduricalhos stands, with the budget dispute still open at the Court.
stf.mendonca: He remains the rapporteur in the Vorcaro case, having authorised the Federal Police on Jul 23 to open an inquiry into the banker’s payments for the film about Jair Bolsonaro, with a scope of corruption and money laundering. No new individual action captured over the weekend.
stf.nexo: The weekend nexus was entirely sovereign and escalated in three stages. First, Itamaraty denied visas to two State Department officials who intended to discuss the Brazilian electoral system, and Lula answered that anyone coming from abroad to meddle in the election will take a beating. Then the American government publicly denied any intention of undermining elections in Brazil (Folha de S.Paulo, Jul 25, 8:05pm). Finally, on Jul 26, the Brazilian government summoned its ambassador in Argentina after Milei’s attack on Moraes. In parallel, the STF still leans towards blocking the pauta-bomba, with Alcolumbre holding back promulgation.
stf.analise: The market on the impeachment of a STF justice before 2027 fell 0.10pp and stood at 3.40% (vol USD 83 thousand), the third day effectively flat. The methodological caveat is worth more than the number: with USD 83 thousand in accumulated volume against USD 115.95M in the presidential market, variation in this book does not support a narrative. What is worth recording is the absence of movement in the face of a sequence of heavy institutional facts within 48 hours: a foreign head of state attacking a justice by name from a Brazilian stage, the president of the Court answering in public, the American government having to deny any intention of interfering in the election, and an ambassador summoned for consultations. None of that moved the price. Real money goes on pricing institutional friction, not removal risk.
